selection_policy.selection_basis: A completed East Asian democratic electoral-process specimen adds greater marginal analytical diversity than another mechanical market-structure occurrence and reuses existing election taxonomy without inventing ontology.
selection_policy.known_bias: South Korea is selected for domain/process diversity, not because East Asia is regionally absent from completed anchors. Climate/environment and corporate/market-structure gaps remain material after this tranche.

new_source.institution: National Election Commission of the Republic of Korea

The nationwide simultaneous election contains many local contests and does not have one synthetic national winner or result.
Public accessibility does not establish unrestricted production crawler permission.
new_source.notes: Canonical factual election metadata only; post-event winner verification is linked from the NEC Policy & Pledge portal. No page-content republication or automated retrieval permission is inferred.

new_source.rights_summary: NEC-owned public works may be freely used where the relevant KOGL marking applies and source attribution is provided; material without KOGL marking requires prior coordination.
new_source.automation_summary: Copyright/reuse status and public accessibility do not establish production crawler permission; endpoint behaviour and permission require separate review.
new_source.rights_review_note: Operational WORLD SIGNALS source-governance classification; not a legal opinion.

guardrails: Election-day milestone is not the early-voting window.

Individual local contests, certification/result milestones and government formation remain separate objects if later required.
Canonical completion uses competent first-party post-event NEC evidence, never elapsed time alone.
No observed market response or causal attribution is written in this tranche.
